Description

TNF released in the inflamed OA joint binds TNFR1 on nociceptors, which recruits the adaptors TRADD, TRAF2 and RIPK1. TRAF2 activates the kinase ASK1, which through MKK3 activates p38 MAP kinase, and p38 sensitises joint nociceptors to movement and enhances sodium currents. CCL2 acts on the same neurons through its own G protein-coupled receptor CCR2, which is required for pain behaviour in mice after meniscal destabilisation.
